params.body:
## What

Ask's icon on the header was a square bubble with a question mark in it, which read as help rather than as a conversation. It is now a round speech bubble with three dots, the shape people know as chat. Testers keeps the square bubble, so the two stay apart in the System menu and on the bar.

## Checked

- Looked at on the team's bar at 1440px, and at 3x.
- `e2e/header.spec.js`, `e2e/ask-panel.spec.js`, `e2e/site-login.spec.js`: all pass. `MenuIcons.jsx` lints clean.
params.title: Ask's icon is a round chat bubble with three dots
